description: Key points of the mouth (mm, atlas frame: +x left, +y up, +z forward) read off a 5 mm midsagittal slab by src/geometry/mouth-landmarks.js, the distances between them and the sagittal lean of the central incisors (degrees from vertical, positive when the upper end leans forward); scripts/build-mouth-reference.mjs rebuilds them from the downloads of scripts/fetch-anatomy.mjs.

hra-male.name: Human Reference Atlas, 3D reference organ: mouth, male, v1.0
hra-male.citation: Schlehlein H (2023) 3D Reference Organ for Mouth, Male, v1.0. Human Reference Atlas, HuBMAP. doi:10.48539/HBM568.RFGM.978. Built on the Visible Human Project: Ackerman MJ (1998) The Visible Human Project. Proceedings of the IEEE 86(3), 504-511. doi:10.1109/5.662875
hra-male.license: CC BY 4.0, HuBMAP Human Reference Atlas
hra-male.notes: A cadaver: the jaw rests with the incisal edges about 2 mm apart vertically and the tongue, with its root, fills the mouth. The hard palate is its oral mucosa (no anterior nasal spine); the soft palate mucosa spans the palatal arches, about 5 cm across, and hangs slack with its tip about 3 cm below the posterior nasal spine. The female mouth is the male one scaled up by about 1.1.
